content:
marco-finance: Sentinel Labs disputed MAY invoice. They say platform fee was charged during a 2.5h planned maintenance and want the platform line removed. They attached a screenshot of a DM between their infra lead and our AM.
ella-sales: AM confirms they saw the DM but didn't send an email. AM says they said "ok noted" on Slack. No ticket or ops@ email. Customer expects that to be sufficient.
pete-cs: checked infra tags: pool `sentinel-prod` has tag `planned:maintenance` 2026-05-14T01:15Z-2026-05-14T03:45Z (2.5h). Reserved commit remained bound. Also saw 1.25h of on-demand post-test usage.
marco-finance: invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-714
reserved_commit_hours 744 => $39,936
platform_fee private => $9,984
support_enterprise => $3,200
```
Customer asks to remove $9,984.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-714 generated 2026-05-16T09:02Z. Metering shows reserved_hours=744 for cust_sent_021. No recorded waiver or approval in billing system.
zoe-legal: contract check: SOW requires written prior approval for billing exemptions. Slack DMs are not explicitly listed. We typically require ops@ or AM-written signoff archived in ticketing.
quentin-cfo: commercial note: this account is mid-enterprise and a churn risk. Recommend we offer a one-time settlement: pro-rated platform fee for verified 2.5h + goodwill credit of $1,000, capped at $2,500. Need finance signoff for >$1,000.
marco-finance: pro-rate calc: $9,984 / 744h = $13.42/hr -> 2.5h => $33.55. With $1,000 goodwill => $1,033.55 round to $1,034.
ella-sales: customer will push for more. Suggest $2,000 if they sign a migration pre-approval workflow (ops@ + AM written ack) and commit to using the new Console toggle.
zoe-legal: we can approve $2,000 settlement provided customer sends written acceptance and signs a short migration addendum. Document the exception in contract folder.
marco-finance: I'll prepare credit memo CM-2026-910 for $2,000 pending acceptance. Ticket #billing-ops-11234. Invoice status set to "offer_pending_acceptance".
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-910 created and queued. Ledger update pending signed settlement.
pete-cs: ops action: add alert rule to flag `planned:maintenance` tags >1h and route to AM for archival approval. Rule id: ops-mig-flag-2026-05.
ella-sales: I'll send settlement offer to Sentinel and request the DM thread be copied into the ticket as supporting evidence.
marco-finance: noted. If customer signs addendum and accepts credit, finance will apply CM-2026-910 and mark INV-2026-714 as "settled".
quentin-cfo: approved. Keep record of this exception so we can analyze settlement trends.
marco-finance: update 11: Sentinel accepted $2,000 credit, signed the addendum, and agreed to the pre-approval workflow. Applying CM-2026-910 now. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
